title: Space Engineers 2
notes: Never got past the startup dialog, so there is no gameplay or fps. The game (App Version 4.0.0.3165) starts, gets D3D12 through D3DMetal, then shows "No supported GPU found" and exits. Its own render log (%APPDATA%\SpaceEngineers2\Temp\Logs\*_Render12.log) says why: Feature level, RAM and ray tracing all pass; the only failing check is DoublePrecisionFloatShaderOps. Apple GPUs have no FP64 in shaders, so this probably can't be fixed on the Mac. Intel Arc A-series fails the same way on Windows, and Keen lists that as a known issue. DXMT/DXVK are no alternative because the game is D3D12 only. Workaround: GeForce NOW streams the Steam version.
issues: Exits at startup with "No supported GPU found": the game's GPU check rejects the adapter because D3DMetal reports no double-precision (FP64) shader ops.
